author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Does Adam Savage have advice for someone who is a big thinker in a way that's not welcome in his or her current position? Any encouraging words for someone who has been laid off and is finishing out his current job? In this live stream excerpt Adam answers these questions from Tested members Gwen-Maker-of-Things and philredbeard, whom we thank for their support!
